description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny” illustrates how word error rate (WER) changes over training epochs for five tiny-model variants. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and spans epochs 0 through 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and shows values roughly from 30 up to 70 with major ticks at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” series is drawn as a solid gray line with circular markers and decreases from about 70 at epoch 0 to about 52 at epoch 4, then rises to about 58 by epoch 6. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” series is a solid gray line with square markers, starting near 61 at epoch 0, dropping to about 55 at epoch 1, then fluctuating around the low-to-mid 50s and ending near 50 at epoch 6. The “tiny int4” series is a dashed gray line with circular markers, beginning around 70 at epoch 0, falling to about 59 at epoch 1 and to roughly 55 by epoch 3, then increasing to about 58 at epoch 6. The “tiny int8” series is a dashed gray line with square markers, starting near 61 at epoch 0, dropping to about 50 at epoch 1, then gradually increasing to around 54 by epoch 6. The “tiny full” series is a dotted gray line with triangular markers, starting around 30 at epoch 0 and increasing steadily across epochs to about 40 at epoch 6.
